title: pinus nigra subsp. clusiana
intro: Pinus nigra subsp. clusiana, commonly known as Black Pine, is a subspecies of pine tree native to the Mediterranean region. The resin and essential oil extracted from Black Pine are used in traditional medicine, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Black Pine include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Black Pine include pinene, limonene, and terpinen-4-ol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
